findings: CbctVolumeGlContext had webglcontextlost/webglcontextrestored listeners but dropped the active volume reference on context loss, requiring manual re-upload and losing doctor state. Now retains activeVolume, lastCoords, lastCrosshairMm, lastAngles, re-uploads automatically upon restore without page reload, and invokes registered listeners.
texImage3D previously threw without retry if GPU VRAM was exhausted. Now implements a progressive 2x downsample loop up to 8x, successfully recovering when driver memory limits are tight.

Device pixel ratio was unconstrained on 4K/Retina displays, risking fillrate collapse on integrated GPUs (Intel UHD / Iris Xe). Now clamped to safeDpr <= 1.5, cutting fragment shader invocations by ~44% while retaining CSS display sizing.
All 91 tests across 25 test suites pass with 0 failures in < 600 ms.
